intendedUse: OCR and extraction benchmark only; not a Tunisian production-accuracy claim
risks: The labeled set is a computer-generated US invoice template in English/USD and is not representative of Tunisian FR/AR invoices.
Exact duplicates must be grouped before train/test splitting to prevent leakage.
Rows with inconsistent totals must not be used as financial ground truth without correction.
No invoice-line to ERP-product labels are present, so product-matching accuracy cannot be trained or claimed from this dataset.
